      "public_names": ["shift"],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "m3",
      "title": "Fix humanize month limits",
      "requests": ["R5"],
      "requirement": "humanize() must correctly handle cases where the time difference spans multiple months, ensuring it doesn't incorrectly report 'a month ago' or similar when the granularity logic should prefer weeks or days based on the actual elapsed time.",
      "observable": "Arrow.utcnow().replace(months=-1, days=-1).humanize(granularity='month') != 'a month ago'; Arrow.utcnow().replace(months=-1).humanize(granularity='month') == 'a month ago'",
      "public_names": ["humanize"],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": ""
    }

    "Developers might confuse the week_start index (0 vs 1 based) with Python's weekday() return values.",

  "verifier_plan": "Tests will instantiate Arrow objects at specific dates/times.
